error.message: The loop through MIX13, MIX3, PUMP14, KREA4, SCDS5, HTXR6, MIX7, EXTR8, SPLIT9, HTXR19, HTXR10, HTXR18, SCDS15, SCDS11, SPLIT16, HTXR12, HTXR17 did not converge: at iteration 4, Column SCDS11: the rigorous column did not converge. Tried: Newton from the bubble-point start, steps of at most 20 K (12 iterations, 5503 ms: the residual fell only from 0.00004536 to 0.0000393 in 12 iterations); continuation in the relative volatilities (stopped at 99.32 % of the way, after 15 steps, 57657 ms); Newton resumed from where the bubble-point start stopped, without the early stop (100 iterations in all, 21041 ms: 88 iterations were not enough); continuation in the relative volatilities, the mean weighted by the liquid (stopped at 97.31 % of the way, after 17 steps, 62056 ms). Last residuals: material 0.00007913 mol/s, equilibrium 0.00001167, energy 19.06 W, specifications 1.003e-16. Two liquids are allowed on the stages (phases "VLL"); on the last iterate stages 1, 2 held two liquids. Newton converges slowly where a stage's liquid sits at the edge of the two-liquid region. This does not show that the column has no solution: try other specifications (a larger reflux, another product flow), more stages, or another feed stage. (on an accelerated guess, broyden, 0.078 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 7.29e-3. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (S27, S7, S21, S15, S24) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
